description.html: This water dish styled as rough grey stone has an irregular, broken rim and a neutral grey-brown color. The inside is smoother and lighter, with soft swirls, so the water looks as if it is sitting in a hollow of natural rock.

The biggest advantage of this dish is that it fits in almost anywhere. The grey-brown tone does not clash with sand, bark, soil or moss, so it is a good choice when you are not sure how you will decorate the terrarium or you change the setup often. It suits lizards, snakes and geckos as a permanent water source.

A slippery layer of bacteria quickly forms on the walls of a water dish, and animals often bring substrate or droppings into the water. So change the water every day and wash the dish with a brush and warm water whenever the surface feels slimy. Brush the rough edges on all sides.
Put the dish on the cooler side of the terrarium on a level surface so it does not wobble when your animal steps on the rim.
